non_conformities.title: Pydantic V2 Migration Warnings
non_conformities.description: Deprecation warnings present during test suite execution due to Pydantic V1 class-based Config and @validator usage in backend/config.py.

risk_acceptance.rationale: Pydantic V1 compatibility layer active; zero functional failure in API or models.

non_conformities.corrective_action: Migrate backend/config.py to Pydantic V2 ConfigDict and @field_validator in Release v3.1.
non_conformities.verification_method: Run pytest tests/ without Pydantic V2 deprecation warnings.
non_conformities.evidence: Pytest warning logs in task execution

non_conformities.title: Single-Node PostgreSQL Staging HA Limitation
non_conformities.description: Staging environment operates on single-node PostgreSQL instance without active-active multi-region replication.
affected_claims: CLM-008 (High Availability - FLAGGED AS PROHIBITED IN STAGING)
non_conformities.production_impact: Staging single point of failure; RPO < 24h & RTO < 1h backup/restore active

risk_acceptance.rationale: Staging deployment operates under documented single-node staging HA constraint.

non_conformities.corrective_action: Deploy multi-region active-passive PostgreSQL cluster during production expansion.
non_conformities.verification_method: Simulated node failover & replication lag measurement under load.
non_conformities.evidence: Single container PostgreSQL staging deployment config
